name: How much does a room addition cost in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a room addition cost in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a room addition in Las Vegas varies significantly based on several factors, including the size and complexity of the addition, materials chosen, interior finishes, and any necessary site preparation. A small, basic room addition might start from around $40,000 to $60,000, while a larger, more custom project with high-end finishes could easily exceed $100,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room addition costs in Las Vegas vary based on size, complexity, materials, and finishes. Basic additions may start around $40,000, while larger projects can exceed $100,000.
